Title: The Doctrine and Covenants - Section 20: Organization and Endowments

Content.description: Describes the organizational structure of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints, including the roles of elders, bishops, presbyters, teachers and deacons.
Details the process for baptism, including administration by authorized individuals and appropriate language to be used during the ordinance.
Explains the proper way to administer the sacrament of communion (also called the Lord's Supper), including prayer over the elements and the symbolic meaning behind them.
Outlines procedures for dealing with members who violate church discipline, including expelling those who do not repent.
Addresses record keeping practices within the church, such as maintaining membership records and handling transfers between congregations.
